description: Source code for a VS Code extension provider class that manages interactions with VS Code's Language Model API, including model selection, message streaming, token counting, and model info retrieval.

classes.name: VsCodeLmHandler
classes.description: A class extending BaseProvider to handle interactions with VS Code's Language Model API, including model management, message streaming, token counting, and model info.

methods.name: convertToVsCodeLmTools
methods.description: Converts OpenAI ChatCompletionTool definitions to VS Code LanguageModelChatTool format, normalizing schemas.

methods.name: initializeClient
methods.description: Initializes the VS Code Language Model client, creating a new client if not already initialized.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a VS Code LanguageModelChat client based on a selector, returning a default minimal client if no models are found.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Streams a message response from the VS Code Language Model API, handling text and tool call chunks, with token counting and error handling.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns model information based on the current client, including support features and description.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the VS Code Language Model API.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in Anthropic content blocks for the VS Code LM.

methods.name: internalCountTokens
methods.description: Internal method to count tokens in a string or message, with error handling.

methods.name: calculateTotalInputTokens
methods.description: Calculates total tokens for a list of messages.

methods.name: ensureCleanState
methods.description: Cancels ongoing requests and disposes of cancellation tokens.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the VS Code LM client based on options.

methods.name: cleanMessageContent
methods.description: Recursively cleans message content for safe processing.
